policy: Version 2.4.0 preserves every 2.3.0 rule and requires internal closure to keep independentReview and independent Red Team verdicts unapproved. The live policy is checked by a mandatory regression; an invocation cannot select an earlier policy. Sealed subjects declaring earlier versions retain their original field semantics, including internal Red Team records, without gaining an independent attestation. Under 2.3.0 LESSONS.md is exactly the rendered lessons.jsonl index. Under 2.2.0 every guardrail registry entry resolves its own kind and reference through the shared effectiveness control. Under 2.1.0 prose cannot contradict lesson status. Under 2.0.0 every GUARDED lesson names a registered guardrail, all control/evidence references resolve, and provenance locators resolve against their source checkpoint. The registry remains fixed at .iacode/memory/guardrails/registry.json.
